faqs.a: Inspections are required for most permit types. Inspections can be scheduled until 6 am of the desired inspection date. In a weather event such as a hailstorm, inspections are not guaranteed to be completed by the next business day. Inspections are completed Monday through Friday, 8 am to 4 pm. All inspection can be scheduled using Arvada's permit site or by calling 720-898-7630 and using the automated line. A 3-digit inspection code is required. Required inspections will vary depending on the scope and nature of your project. Someone over the age of 18 is required to be available during the inspection.
